summary: Official warnings state that taking lopinavir alongside certain other medications may cause important drug interactions [3]. A small computer program, rather than tests done on human patients, rated this medicine as a low risk for both liver and heart problems [M]. In research, one study was stopped because of a surprisingly high number of treatment failures [6]. Other trials ended early because of low event counts or an inability to enroll the required number of patients [5][7].
